summary: No Netflix-specific news dated Nov 4-5 changes the research: the SEC filing list shows only routine insider-sale notices (Forms 144 and 4) and no 8-K since the Oct 20 earnings release, and searches found no new deal, pricing, ad-tier, content or analyst items in the window. The Nov 5 drop to 65.56 (66.39 the day before) coincides with a roughly 5.5% fall in the Nasdaq and is a price move with no new company facts, so the research target (12m) stands.

items.headline: Netflix insiders file Form 144 notices (proposed share sales) and Form 4 reports
items.why: Routine executive and director sales filings of the kind Netflix has shown every month since August; they add no facts about cash flows, risk or catalysts. Filing list read directly from the SEC submissions feed.

items.headline: No company filing, deal, pricing, ad-tier, content or Warner Bros / Paramount item found for Nov 4-5
items.why: Latest 8-K is the Oct 20 earnings release (items 2.02, 9.01) and the latest 10-Q is Oct 21, both before the window; Twelve Data company news shows no Netflix release after Sept 14 except older items. The Paramount-WBD close (Oct 6) is already in the research. Press-wire and search results surfaced no dated Nov 4-5 analyst action or sector item specific to Netflix.

items.headline: NFLX closes 65.56 (66.39 on Nov 4) as the Nasdaq falls about 5.5%
items.why: Price move only, in line with a broad market selloff; a price move alone is never a thesis trigger, and no Netflix-specific cause was found. The stock is still above the 48 thesis-break close level in the supervisor note. Price figures come from the task context, not a source I opened.
